thesis: Peter Buffett argues that modern society suffers from a fundamental disconnection from nature and community, describing humanity as a species 'out of context' that is displaced from its natural state. He proposes that the antidote to this displacement is rooted in connection to specific places and people, illustrating this by detailing how his foundation purchased a farm and settled in Kingston to re-knit the fabric of community and move beyond abstract metrics to experience the 'particular' reality of life.
